purpose: Preflight ontology/gene-disease validity sources for MYH7 to frame subtypes for the myosin_inhibitor_rescue hypothesis

sources_attempted.outcome: failed - no public JSON API (HTTP 404). GenCC curated gene-disease validity for MYH7 exists on the website/TSV export but was NOT programmatically accessed. Labeled UNVERIFIED via API; curator should consult GenCC web export.

gene_to_disease_associations_returned.label: congenital myopathy 7A, myosin storage, autosomal dominant

interpretation: Monarch confirms MYH7 is a Mendelian gene with a multi-entity disease spectrum: distal/skeletal myopathy (Laing, MONDO:0008050), myosin storage myopathy (dominant MONDO:0008409 and recessive MONDO:0009708), multiminicore, plus cardiomyopathies (DCM, LVNC, and HCM not shown in top-20). The seed hypothesis targets the DRX-hypercontractile skeletal subtype; the storage-myopathy entities are a mechanistically distinct (aggregation) subtype.
limitations: Monarch aggregates multiple upstream sources; gene-disease validity scoring (Definitive/Strong/Limited) should be verified in ClinGen/GenCC directly. Only the first 20 of 284 associations were inspected.
